description: Returns the comparable fields of 2 to 5 firms in one call: category, type, location, primary and secondary domains, stage, check size, AUM as stored, year founded, team size, giant flag, wealth origin and family name (family offices), philanthropy causes, decision-maker count, work emails on record, latest news date, upcoming event on record. Each firm whose full record is returned counts once per seat per calendar month toward the allowance of 500 firms a month (opening it again this month is free); past the allowance the firm's teaser is returned instead. Useful for side-by-side questions; one call covers what opening each firm would.
name: compare_investors
title: Compare investors
